Use case: identity-preserve. Create a GAME PIXEL SPRITE ANIMATION of precisely image 1, the corrected master. Image 2 is the original design for exact face/armor identity only. Keep image 1's original detailed pixel shading, muted dark crimson/plum black/antique gold colors, compact horn crown, bangs and red eyes, large-head body proportions, high long dark ponytail with dark red stripe, exact layered shoulder/hip armor, red gold waist emblem, long flame-emblem tabard, ragged red tails, armored boots. No redesign, no chibi, no taller legs, no enlarged bust, no coarse pixel simplification, no bright scarlet recoloring, no different face.
WEAPON IS LOCKED: SAME ONE-HANDED REVERSE GRIP AS MASTER IN EVERY FRAME. Only rear-side lowered hand by hip holds shaft. Other front hand EMPTY. Exactly one identical polearm: long straight shaft diagonal '/' from lower-left to upper-right, identical curved red-black silver-edged blade mounted at LOWER LEFT near floor, butt with red tassel at UPPER RIGHT. Blade socket axis and pole shaft ALWAYS COLLINEAR and straight, no crooked joint. Whole weapon moves as ONE RIGID OBJECT with the gripping hand, NEVER bends, separates, changes length, becomes two-handed or changes end. No second blade. Blade itself remains curved as master.
OUTPUT exactly SIXTEEN DISTINCT successive poses in an EVENLY SPACED 4 COLUMNS x 4 ROWS square sheet, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Perfect equal cells. 2048x2048 if possible. Each cell has same character scale, same 3/4 RIGHT facing camera, shared root at 62% cell width with feet on 88% cell height; whole crown, trailing hair, entire polearm blade and butt INSIDE its own cell, at least 6% empty margin on all four sides, generous gutters. No overlaps between cells or cut-off extremities. Full character body height about 73% cell height. Background must be TRUE RGBA TRANSPARENT, clean opaque character interiors and clean hard stepped pixel edges. NO white film, pale matte, glow, fog, floor shadow, red/cyan marks, stray colored speckles, painted checkerboard, text, numbers, grid borders. All sixteen same identity and same straight rigid weapon.
idle: ACTION: 16-frame seamless IDLE breathing loop. Same alert upright neutral pose as image 1, feet fixed apart, only subtle chest/shoulder breathing inhale 1-8 then exhale 9-16, hair tips and tassels/cloth gently lag. Lowered hand carries reversed polearm stably on a straight diagonal '/'. Empty hand relaxed. Minimal consistent change between frames, small independent motions, last transitions naturally to first.
walk: ACTION: 16-frame seamless WALK-IN-PLACE loop to right, complete two-foot gait. Frame 1 near/right foot FORWARD contact and far/left foot back; 2-4 near foot plants while far foot swings; 5 passing; 6-8 far foot reaches forward; 9 far/left foot FORWARD contact and near/right foot back; 10-12 near foot swings; 13 passing; 14-16 near foot reaches forward to the first contact. True alternating legs, do not duplicate half-cycle. Body stays centered, gentle hip/shoulder bob. Ponytail and cloth secondary motion. ONE lowered rear-side hand carries rigid reversed polearm throughout, blade down-left and butt up-right; free hand swings only slightly without touching weapon. Natural grounded walking, not marching or running. No body turn. Last transitions to first.
finish: Native-alpha background extraction, binary pixel alpha, whole-pixel registration; no pose interpolation or geometry scaling.
